parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The schedule description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end date of the schedule. The value is in the yyyy-MM-dd format and cannot be earlier than StartDate.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The daily end time of the schedule. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The schedule name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.

parameters.name: ScheduleCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the schedule.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date of the schedule. The value is in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The daily start time of the schedule. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The schedule status. Valid values:

- **WORKING**: Enabled.

- **STOP**: Disabled.
